title: La polizia sta a guardare
writer: Augusto Caminito, Marcello D'Amico, Roberto Infascelli
actors: Enrico Maria Salerno, Lee J. Cobb, Jean Sorel
plot: Commissioner Cardone arrives in a small town in North Italy, where he declares war to a criminal gang specialized in kidnapping of young rich boys; a war that may cost him both his job and his family.
